title: Cloudflare Launches Clairic Model for Continuous Data Extraction

tickers.name: Cloudflare, Inc. Class A common stock, par value $0.001 per share

summary:
System One AI models are expanding in capability with the introduction of a tool that can compute and forecast data from unorganized sources. Cloudflare introduced the model, named Clairic, which uses a regression-based architecture instead of the classification methods used in decision models like Clef. This technical shift allows the tool to estimate continuous values without requiring a user to exhaustively list all possible choices beforehand.

The company will release open weights for the model soon. Industry observers note that while many current decision models are still large language models at their core, the shift toward specialized System One designs like Clairic and Jev could mark a turning point for the sector.
